title: [Bug]: Gemma4 parser classifies plain output without channel markers differently in streaming and non-streaming mode
author: DavidDiao

comments.author: adesai-24
comments.body: Hello, I would love to take a crack at this bug, will being working on fixing this bug!

comments.author: lcw99
comments.body:
I independently hit the same root cause on `v0.25.0` with
`google/gemma-4-31B-it-qat-w4a16-ct` (reasoning + tool parser `gemma4`).
Confirming: `adjust_initial_state_from_prompt` unconditionally pre-inits
`REASONING` for any new-turn prompt (since `is_reasoning_end` returns `False`
on `<|turn>` when thinking is enabled), so channel-less direct answers stream
entirely as `reasoning` with empty `content`. The fix in this PR matches my
local reproduction — thanks for picking it up.

One related but SEPARATE bug this PR does not cover, which becomes visible
precisely after bug 1 is fixed (because normal text now correctly flows through
CONTENT): the `<turn|>` EOT token (and `<eos>`) can leak verbatim into the
streamed `content` field.

Root cause: `StreamingParserEngine._on_terminal` only drops these special
tokens (mapped to the internal `DROP_TERMINAL`) when they arrive WITH their
token ID in the same delta. In a streaming race where the detokenizer flushes
the token's text BEFORE its token ID reaches the parser, the text is lexed as
plain `CONTENT` and emitted as-is.

Minimal repro (no model/GPU needed):
```python
from vllm.parser.gemma4 import Gemma4Parser
# build parser with enable_thinking=True, feed a new-turn prompt tail
out = parser.parse_delta(
    "The answer is 4.<turn|>",          # text includes EOT
    token_ids_for("The answer is 4."),  # but token id for <turn|> NOT in this delta
    finished=True,
)
# -> content == "The answer is 4.<turn|>"   (leaked!)
